primary_method: V2 regularized logistic procedure selected solely inside development training folds
model_selection: Three target-stratified inner folds; pooled inner OOF log loss selects C and unweighted/balanced/optional cross-fitted sigmoid calibration
threshold_selection: F1 maximized on selected candidate inner OOF scores over 0.05..0.95 in 0.01 increments; ties closest to 0.5 then higher
final_training: 242 frozen development records; no final holdout fitting, calibration, threshold selection or feature-profile selection
evaluation: 61 frozen final holdout records scored once after this freeze; ROC-AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, F1, Brier, confusion counts and conditional patient-bootstrap intervals
availability_profiles: Exploratory development comparisons; reduced profiles do not replace the primary full-input procedure
post_evaluation_policy: Do not retune models or thresholds using final outcomes. UI, reproducibility and presentation fixes may continue with scores retained.
